date.value: 1959 on Commons; 11–12 October 1958 in the Richter discography.
date.note: The Commons filename and date field say 1959, with no support for the 1 January day. The discography identifies a 1958 session with the same soloist, conductor and orchestra. The carrier underlying the Commons file has not been independently matched, so both dates remain visible.

composition.value: Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies.
composition.note: The composer died in 1856. This is a term calculation, not a worldwide clearance or a statement about an unidentified modern edition.

recording.value: Commons applies PD-EU-audio: expiry of European performers’ and phonogram producers’ rights.
recording.note: This is a territory-specific expiry claim, not CC0 or permission from the record company. The 70-year extension did not revive recordings whose earlier term had already expired by 1 November 2013. It does not establish public-domain status in the United States. The session attribution itself is disputed between 1958 and 1959. No individual issue has been established as the transfer source, and this is not a CC0 dedication or US clearance.
